name: webpilot
description: Steuerbarer Browser mit Aktions-Recorder und MCP-Anbindung

scripts.open: npm run build && node dist/cli.js open
scripts.record: npm run build && node dist/cli.js record
scripts.replay: npm run build && node dist/cli.js replay
scripts.test: npm run build && node test/e2e.mjs && node test/mcp-client.mjs
